sourceTask.title: 混凝土柱轴压加水平力
sourceTask.difficultyReason: 两个力分量分别对应轴向与弯曲响应，需正确映射自由度和结果分量。
sourceTask.inputForm: 完整文字任务 + 随题分析属性表（待编制）
sourceTask.scenario: 高4.2m、450×450mm，底固定，顶向下600kN及X向30kN，一阶弹性；完整属性按公共契约随题给出。 轴压600kN与水平30kN都在柱顶，明确一阶弹性、不启用P-Delta。
sourceTask.expectedOutput: 柱顶X/Z位移和Y转角、柱底轴力/剪力/弯矩。
sourceTask.gradingFocus: 轴向和侧向分量分开；指定位置/分量对照数值真值，输出文字与结构化结果保持符号、单位和工况一致。
sourceTask.reuseChange: 保留旧题主要几何与荷载，显式补齐单位、自重、观测位置和结果评分；新契约下须重新核验真值。

appendixDecisions: The source leaves the concrete grade and elastic constants unspecified. The appendix freezes C30 with E=30000 MPa, nu=0.2, G=12500 MPa and rho=2500 kg/m³; the given 450x450 mm section is retained.

The base-section result is located at member column, position 0 m, side right. Both local section forces and global support reactions are requested to disambiguate the source phrase 'base axial force/shear/moment'.
The top axial and lateral forces are simultaneous components of case D. They do not activate P-Delta or change the prescribed first-order model.

All members use first-order linear elastic Euler-Bernoulli bending, axial deformation and finite Saint-Venant torsion stiffness. Shear deformation and self-weight are disabled. No geometric stiffness, buckling, capacity or reinforcement assessment is requested.
Section properties A, Iy, Iz and J are explicit inputs in SI units. Rectangular-section J uses the numerical approximation supplied in input-data.json; no default section properties may replace it.
